name: House Share Restricted Residential Zone Precincts

Metadata.Data Owner: Department of Business Affairs & Consumer Protection

columns.name: Precinct
columns.description: The Precinct within the ward. The same precinct numbers exist in different wards so this column is only meaningful in combination with the Ward column

columns.name: Submission Date
columns.description: Date the petition was filed to prohibit house share rentals in this precinct.

columns.name: Comment Period End Date
columns.description: Deadline for public comments on the proposed prohibition.

columns.name: Ordinance Introduction Date
columns.description: Date the City Council ordinance was introduced to prohibit house share rentals in this precinct.

columns.name: Ordinance Effective Date
columns.description: Date when the prohibition on house share rentals in this precinct took effect or will take effect, at 10 am.

columns.name: Scope of Restriction
columns.description: The restriction placed by the ordinance or proposed if no ordinance has passed yet.

columns.name: Enacting Ordinance
columns.description: A link to the City Council ordinance to prohibit house share rentals in this precinct.

columns.name: Repeal Submission Date
columns.description: Date the petition was filed to repeal the prohibition on house share rentals in this precinct.

columns.name: Repeal Comment Period End Date
columns.description: Deadline for public comments on the proposed prohibition repeal.

columns.name: Repeal Ordinance Introduction Date
columns.description: Date the City Council ordinance was introduced to repeal the prohibition on house share rentals in this precinct.

columns.name: Repeal Ordinance Effective Date
columns.description: Date on which the prohibition on house share rentals in this precinct was lifted or will be lifted.

columns.name: Repeal Ordinance
columns.description: A link to the City Council ordinance to repeal the prohibition on house share rentals in this precinct.
